sharedRules.name: Stormtroopers
sharedRules.description: A Unit may attempt a second Movement Order after succeeding in its first Movement Order. The second Movement Order must be different from the first.

sharedRules.name: Third Reich
sharedRules.description: Troops of the Third Reich have a better Last Stand rating.

sharedRules.name: Tiger Ace
sharedRules.description: Tiger Aces have a better Last Stand rating and a significantly better Remount rating.

sharedRules.name: Bazooka Skirts
sharedRules.description: A Tank Team with Bazooka Skirts increases its Side armour to 5 against weapons with Firepower 5+ or 6.

sharedRules.name: Flame Tank
sharedRules.description: Flame tanks cannont Charge Into Contact and have an Assault rating of 5+.

sharedRules.name: Flame-thrower
sharedRules.description:
Infantry, Gun and Unarmoured Tank Teams re-roll successful Saves when hit by a Flame-thrower and the Unit is automatically Pinned Down. Armoured Tank Teams use their Top armour for Armour Saves when hit by a Flame-thrower.

Flame-throwers my shoot in Defensive Fire. However, while a Unit that is Hit by a Flame-thrower is Pinned Down, this does not automatically stop the assault. The defender still needs to score five (or eight) hits to stop the assault as normal.

sharedRules.name: HEAT
sharedRules.description: A Team's Armour rating is not increased by +1 if it is more than 16"/40cm away when hit by HEAT weapons.

sharedRules.name: Mounted Assault
sharedRules.description: This Team has Assault 4+ and Counterattack 4+ with one Passanger and Assault 3+ and Counterattack 4+ with two or three Passangers. This is shown on the Sd Kfz 251 Transport unit card as an additional motivation and skill column.

sharedRules.name: Panzerfaust - Limited 1
sharedRules.description:
Each time this Unit shoots, one of its Teams my shoot as a Panzerfaust rather than its usual weapons.

Each time this Unit rolls To Hit in an assault, one of its Teams may attack with a Panzerfaust rather than its usual weapons.

sharedRules.name: Unit Transport
sharedRules.description: The Unit Leader of the Transport Attachment must end the Movement Step within 6"/15cm of the Unit Leader of its Passenger Unit while on the table. If it cannot do this, then the Transport Attachment must be Sent to the Rear (see page 45 of the rulebook).

sharedRules.name: Salvo
sharedRules.description:
Weapons with a ROF of 'SALVO' are Artillery weapons and fire Artillery Bombardments, but use a 10"/25cm square Salvo Template rather than the normal 6"/15cm Artillery Template.

A Salvo Template may not be placed within 6"/15cm of a friendly Team.

sharedRules.name: Flying Tank
sharedRules.description: Flying Tanks have a worse Is Hit On rating, but a better Save.

sharedRules.name: Protected Ammo
sharedRules.description: Tanks with Protected Ammo have a better Remount rating.

characteristics.name: Info
characteristics.$text: Some men have all the luck.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Discard this card to re-roll any one die. The second result must be used.

characteristics.name: Info
characteristics.$text: The pioneers of the German army proved their worth in clearing Soviet minefields and barbed wire ahead of the infantry assault, despite heavy enemy fire.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Infantry Teams in this Formation cross Minefields safely on a roll of 2+.
Infantry Units in this Formation Dig In on a roll of 2+.

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: German, Build, Formation (Grenadier Company, Panzer Grenadier Company)

characteristics.name: Info
characteristics.$text: The elite crews of these Tiger tanks have learned many tricks on the Eastern Front.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Before Deploying this Unit, roll a die and give this Unit the following command card at no additional point cost:
1: Clever Hans
2: Deadly Gunner
3: Rapid Fire
4: Schnell!
5: Roll Over Them
6: Choose one of the above

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: German, Unit (Tiger Tank Company HQ, Tiger Tank Platoon)

characteristics.name: Info
characteristics.$text: With a deadly gunner in your Tiger, every shot hits exactly where it’s aimed.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
The Unit Leader may re-roll one failed Firepower Test during the Shooting Step. 
*Use the Tiger Ace Skill card to get this card.

characteristics.name: Info
characteristics.$text: It’s hard not to attract attention in agiant 56-tonne tank, but some crews have the knack. Smooth movement and staying to low ground can make even a Tiger tank hard to spot.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
This Unit gains the Scout rule.
Scout: Teams remain Gone to Ground whileMoving unless they Shoot or Assault. *Use the Tiger Ace Skill card to get this card.

characteristics.name: Info
characteristics.$text: An ace gunner and an experienced loader allow a tank to engage and destroy numerous targets in a short span of time.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
The Unit Leader’s Tiger tank has Halted ROF 3 with its 8.8cm gun. 
*Use the Tiger Ace Skill card to get this card.

characteristics.name: Info
characteristics.$text: Most of their kills have been racked up through being in the right place at the right time!

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
This Unit passes Blitz Move tests on 2+. 
*Use the Tiger Ace Skill card to get this card.

characteristics.name: Info
characteristics.$text: In a Tiger tank, it’s easy. You just roll over them. Keep moving and there’s nothing they can do to stop you.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
This Unit Leader’s Tiger tank hits in Assaults on 2+.
*Use the Tiger Ace Skill card to get this card.

characteristics.name: Info
characteristics.$text: Most of the German infantry on the Eastern Front marched on foot. However, somewere fully motorised with excellent German 4-wheel-drive trucks and half-tracks that allowed the infantry and guns to keep pace with the tanks on long marches.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
This Infantry or Gun Unit may add a Softskin Transport Attachment. The number of vehicles in the Unit is as follows:
• Add one Softskin Transport for every two Infantry Teams in the Unit.
• Add one Softskin Transport for each Gun Team in the Unit. 
The characteristics of a Softskin Transport are shown on the back of this card.

rules.name: Passengers 2
rules.description: Team can carry two Infantry Teams as Passangers

rules.name: Tractor
rules.description: Team can carry one Gun Team as Passangers.

rules.name: Softskin
rules.description: If a Transport is Destroyed, any Passangers it is carrying are also Destroyed, and all Tranports must be Sent to the Rear immediately. All Passangers must Dismount from this Unit at the same time. Empty Tranpost Teams must be Sent to the Rear

rules.name: Unarmoured
rules.description: Tram cannot Charge into Contact and must Break Off if Assaulted
